The '''siege''' of [[Bomis Koori system/Legends|Bomis Koori]] took place in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It saw the defeat of [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] at the hands of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Nantz]] and the New Republic's [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Prentioch was captured in the fighting and his [[Prentioch's Dominion|warlord empire]] fell as a result.<ref name="TEA" />
